name: umlautadaptarr
description: A tool to work around Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr and Readarr's problems with foreign languages and symbols, like the German umlauts. Don't forget to update the URLs of your indexers in Prowlarr or directly in the used arr apps. Details are found in the documentation.

variables.name: Sonarr Host
variables.description: URL of the Sonarr instance (e.g. http://192.168.0.100:8989)

variables.name: Sonarr API Key
variables.description: The API Key of Sonarr found under Settings-General

variables.name: Radarr Host
variables.description: URL of the Radarr instance (e.g. http://192.168.0.100:7878)

variables.name: Radarr API Key
variables.description: The API Key of Radarr found under Settings-General

variables.name: Readarr Host
variables.description: URL of the Readarr instance (e.g. http://192.168.0.100:8787)

variables.name: Readarr API Key
variables.description: The API Key of Readarr found under Settings-General

variables.name: Lidarr Host
variables.description: URL of the Lidarr instance (e.g. http://192.168.0.100:8686)

variables.name: Lidarr API Key
variables.description: The API Key of Lidarr found under Settings-General
